title: Sturdy Bed
text: Sturdy Bed. This twin sized bed frame is very sturdy. When I say there is no sound, creaks, or sag, I mean there is none. I've had a 200 pound man use this bed daily for three months and it was good the first day as it was the last. The only negative is that it is short and low to the ground. There isn't a lot of clearance under the bed so suitcases or anything bulky can't fit. You can get supports to lift the frame but I can't attest if it will decrease the stability of the bed when being used. Also, it folds up when not in use. It was delivered in one piece, already assembled and when done using it will fold completely in half. Very convenient. Overall, highly recommend.
